scene_timeline.visual_description: The creator, Cody Sabol, begins a speed painting on a large black canvas, rapidly applying red and orange paint to form the initial shapes of a figure.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Upbeat, epic orchestral music with a heroic theme plays.
scene_timeline.text_on_screen: Painting Andrew Garfield Spider-Man in 7 Minutes‼️

scene_timeline.visual_description: The creator continues to build the red and orange form on the canvas, then briefly turns to the camera and gives a thumbs up.
scene_timeline.text_on_screen: Painted LIVE at a middle school‼️

scene_timeline.visual_description: The creator starts to define the head and mask of Spider-Man by adding white and blue paint to the emerging figure.
scene_timeline.text_on_screen: Because I had to teach these kids who the best Spider-Man is‼️

scene_timeline.visual_description: The creator refines the details of the Spider-Man suit, focusing on the red and black areas and the character's hand.
scene_timeline.text_on_screen: Also, shout out to 8th grader Levi who filmed this on my iPhone.

scene_timeline.visual_description: The creator adds more blue paint to the background around Spider-Man's head and shoulders, and sharpens the white eye lenses on the mask.
The creator applies the final details to the Spider-Man painting, including the web lines on the suit, and steps back to observe the completed artwork.
scene_timeline.audio_description: The epic orchestral music continues to build in intensity.

scene_timeline.visual_description: The creator dramatically throws yellow paint onto the finished canvas, then bows to an unseen audience, revealing the completed Andrew Garfield Spider-Man portrait.
scene_timeline.audio_description: The epic orchestral music reaches a crescendo and then fades out.

parsed_output.overall_summary: This video showcases artist Cody Sabol (codysabolart) performing a live speed painting of Andrew Garfield's Spider-Man in just 7 minutes. The artist, on a stage in a middle school, rapidly transforms a black canvas into a vibrant portrait of the superhero, using bold strokes and splashes of color. The video highlights the artist's skill and his playful assertion that Andrew Garfield is the 'best Spider-Man,' concluding with a dramatic final paint throw and a bow to the audience.
